Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0011 2026-10-21
SHIFT NOTES — Morning Reviewer Cover for the
Avionics Desk
Date: 2026-10-21
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
06:45 — PERSON-0029 opens the avionics coordination desk for
TEAM-0005. Today's handover concerns reviewer coverage and the
Paperwork associated with ISSUE-0040. Keep TASK-0108 as the
task reference on the appointment sheet; do not copy its
category into a coverage note.
08:20 — Ask the review roster clerk to reserve a receiving
reviewer for work presented in the awaiting review category.
The booking must identify the person, the covered interval,
and the substitute role if the person is called away. The duty
coordinator handles an unfilled interval before the outgoing
desk leaves.
09:40 — Send the review envelope to the roster clerk. It
contains the question, record reference, expected reply role,
and requested discussion slot. Put the review purpose on the
front so the appointment can be routed without reading every
attachment.
11:10 — Keep documentation scheduling with the documentation
coordinator. TASK-0109 may locate that separate discussion. An
available reviewer does not absorb responsibility for
gathering missing papers.
Next-shift list
~ Confirm the roster entry with the receiving reviewer and
record the contact time.
~ Keep the appointment sheet beside the avionics desk roster,
with any substitute arrangement visible.
D. Worker 0029
Demo Worker 0029, Demo Team 05
